test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill 2021 is INCORRECT?

options.text: It was introduced in the Rajya Sabha by Smriti Irani, Union Minister for Women and Child Development.
It will apply to all communities/religions in the country.
It seeks to amend the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
It proposes to define a 'child' as 'a male or female who has not completed twenty-one years of age'.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was introduced in the Rajya Sabha by Smriti Irani, Union Minister for Women and Child Development.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill 2021 was introduced in the Lok Sabha, not the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Smriti Irani is indeed the Union Minister for Women and Child Development.
 
• The Bill seeks to amend the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
 
• It proposes to define a 'child' as 'a male or female who has not completed twenty-one years of age'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006**

 
 
• The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 aims to prohibit child marriages in India.
 
• Under this Act, child marriages are not illegal but are voidable at the option of the parties involved, within two years of attaining adulthood.
 
• The Act provides for the appointment of Child Marriage Prohibition Officers to enforce the law.
 
 
 
• **Key Provisions of the Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill 2021**
 
 
• The Bill proposes to increase the minimum age of marriage for women from 18 to 21 years, making it equal to that of men.
 
• It aims to bring uniformity across all communities by applying the provisions of the Bill to all religions and communities in the country.
 
• The Bill seeks to ensure that marriages are based on consent and maturity.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Amendment**
 
 
• The amendment aims to address issues of gender inequality and to promote women's health and education.
 
• Raising the minimum age of marriage is expected to reduce instances of early pregnancies and associated health risks.
 
• It is also expected to provide women with more opportunities for higher education and career advancement.
